content.value_statement: Cloud delivery work often spans many tools and phases. This skill organizes infrastructure, CI/CD, Kubernetes, monitoring, security, costs, and recovery work into clear prompts.
actual_capabilities: Maps cloud infrastructure setup across architecture, networking, billing, provisioning, and IAM.
Guides Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and manifest planning for container delivery.
Provides prompts for CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and rollback planning.
Organizes monitoring, observability, alerting, and dashboard setup work.
Covers cloud security, cost optimization, and disaster recovery planning phases.
limitations: It is a workflow guide and does not provision cloud resources by itself.
It depends on separate named skills that may not be installed in every environment.
It does not validate cloud account permissions, costs, or compliance requirements.
It provides planning prompts, not production-ready infrastructure code.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Cloud Platform
use_cases.description: Create a phase-based plan for accounts, networking, IAM, infrastructure, and deployment readiness.

use_cases.title: Standardize Application Delivery
use_cases.description: Coordinate Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback work for a service launch.

use_cases.title: Review Operational Readiness
use_cases.description: Check security, cost, monitoring, disaster recovery, and runbook coverage before production release.

prompt_templates.title: Outline the Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this cloud DevOps workflow to list the phases for launching my application on a managed cloud platform.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Infrastructure and Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan infrastructure, Terraform tasks, CI/CD stages, and Kubernetes deployment steps for my service.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production Operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to build an operations checklist for monitoring, alerting, secrets, rollback, costs, and disaster recovery.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Cloud Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to compare AWS, Azure, and GCP implementation paths for a secure multi-cloud deployment program.

output_examples.input: Plan a production launch for a containerized web service.
output_examples.output: A phased plan covering architecture, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, security, cost controls, and recovery checks.

output_examples.input: Prepare observability and incident readiness for a cloud application.
output_examples.output: A checklist for metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, failover tests, and post-incident review steps.

output_examples.input: Compare cloud provider tasks for a new platform.
output_examples.output: A provider-focused summary of AWS, Azure, and GCP services with suggested follow-up skills and implementation phases.

best_practices: Start with architecture, identity, networking, and billing before deployment automation.
Validate security, monitoring, and recovery requirements before production release.
Use the named specialist skills only after confirming they are installed and trusted.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the workflow as a substitute for cloud provider documentation.
Do not deploy generated plans without review by qualified platform owners.
Do not skip cost, security, and recovery checks to speed up delivery.

faq.question: Does this skill create infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: No. It organizes planning prompts and workflow phases. Separate tools or engineers must implement the infrastructure.

faq.question: Which cloud providers does it cover?
faq.answer: It references AWS, Azure, and GCP, plus shared DevOps topics such as Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, and monitoring.

faq.question: Can it help with Kubernetes delivery?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes container architecture, Docker, Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, networking, and security policy planning.

faq.question: Does it include security work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers cloud security assessment, security groups, secrets management, network policies, encryption, and audit logging.

faq.question: Can teams use it for production readiness?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes quality gates for infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, security, cost optimization, and disaster recovery.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
